economicIdentity.statement: Bankplassen 4 was a place-bound central-bank workplace and banknote-production site where monetary administration and physical production were combined.
economicIdentity.placeObjectDistinction: Analysen gjelder den tidligere hovedbygningen på Bankplassen 4 og dokumenterte funksjoner der, ikke Norges Bank som helhet eller byggene på Bankplassen 2 og 3.

temporalScope.rationale: Perioden følger bankens hovedsete, trykkeriet, utflyttingen og dokumentert senere statlig eiendomsforvaltning.

businessTopics.siteSpecificRationale: Bygningen var Norges Banks hovedsete og gjør sentralbankens finansielle og institusjonelle funksjon konkret på ett historisk arbeidssted.
Sentralbankarbeid og sikker seddelproduksjon viser hvordan kontroll, tillit og offentlig regulering er innebygd i pengeinfrastrukturen.
Bankfunksjoner og seddeltrykkeri samlet administrativt, teknisk og manuelt arbeid på samme sted, uten at bemanning alene måles som produktivitet.
Trykkeriet 1907–1934 gir en konkret produksjonsprosess der output kan skilles fra kapasitet, bemanning og samfunnsøkonomisk verdi.

sources.sourceLocation: History of Norges Bank – head office and institutional history
sources.limitations: Institutional primary source; used for dates and functions, not independent impact evaluation.

sources.provenance: Norges Banks documented history of banknote printing.
sources.limitations: Describes production history but does not provide a consistent productivity series for Bankplassen 4.

sources.sourceLocation: Sedler utgave II – production and paper
sources.limitations: Documents banknote series and production facts, not all operational inputs or costs.

sources.sourceLocation: Bankplassen 4 – Christiania Theater og Norges Bank
sources.limitations: Place-history source; not a quantitative banking dataset.
Current property-management information does not establish a specific operational use of the building.

economicCases.claim: Bankplassen 4 combined central-bank administration and banknote printing, making monetary infrastructure visible as both institutional coordination and a physical production process.

unitOfAnalysis.boundary: The case covers documented bank and printing functions at this building from 1906, not the entire Norwegian monetary system.

temporalScope.rationale: The period follows the bank as main occupant; the printing sub-period is 1907–1934.

actors.name: Norges Bank and its leadership
actors.roleOrInterest: Organised central-bank administration, monetary functions and the workplace at the head office.
actors.economicPosition: Public monetary institution controlling the organisation of the bank and its printing works.

actors.name: Bank and printing-works employees
actors.roleOrInterest: Performed administrative, technical and physical work required for banking and banknote production.
actors.economicPosition: Labour supplied specialised knowledge and production work within the central-bank organisation.

inputs.statement: Specialised labour, printing equipment, banknote paper, organisational rules and secure premises were documented inputs.

activity.statement: The site combined central-bank administration with printing of Norwegian banknotes during the 1907–1934 production period.

outputs.statement: The printing works produced banknotes, while the head office supplied monetary and administrative infrastructure whose value is not reducible to physical output.

valueCreationAssessment.statement: The sources document functions, staffing context and production history but do not support a site-level estimate of productivity or net social value.

measurement.indicatorOrObservation: Dates, staffing context, printing location and the documented move to a separate printing building are used as institutional and production indicators.
measurement.comparability: The evidence permits comparison of functions and organisational phases, but not a homogeneous time series for productivity.
measurement.dataLimitations: No consistent site-level series for printing volume, labour hours, costs, error rates or monetary-policy outcomes is available in this package.

distributionAndPower.ownershipOrControl: Norges Bank controlled the workplace, production organisation and institutional decisions documented for the site.
distributionAndPower.laborPosition: Employees carried out specialised bank and printing work; the open sources do not support detailed wage or bargaining-power analysis.
beneficiaries: The monetary system gained a centralised institutional workplace and domestic banknote production.
Bank and payment users depended on trusted monetary infrastructure.
costRiskBearers: Norges Bank bore organisational and production responsibilities.
Employees and suppliers were exposed to operational changes such as relocation of the printing works.

riskAssessment.statement: Banknote production and central-bank administration depended on security, reliable materials, specialised labour and institutional trust.

externalityAssessment.rationale: The selected sources do not support a robust site-specific quantification of external costs or benefits attributable to Bankplassen 4 itself.

comparisonAndCausality.comparisonBasis: The institutional history is compared with printing-works documentation and place history to separate organisational relocation, production relocation and later reuse.
comparisonAndCausality.causalAssessment: The sources document sequence and stated growth before the 1934 printing-works move, but do not isolate one causal effect on productivity or monetary outcomes.
alternativeExplanations: Security needs, space constraints, technology, staffing and wider organisational growth could all shape relocation decisions.
comparisonAndCausality.uncertainty: The package documents what happened and where more strongly than counterfactual causes or measured efficiency effects.

presentOperation.statement: Bankplassen 4 is no longer Norges Banks head office; the 2025 annual report documents transfer of property-management responsibility to Forsvarsbygg from 1 January 2026.
presentOperation.originalEconomicRoleRelationship: Current property management does not continue the historical central-bank and printing functions and must not be interpreted as proof of a specific operational defence use.

chronologyStories.rationale: The source-led place chronology is carried by dated place/Fagverk material; no forced episode is added, and the Christiania Theater layer remains an existing historical layer rather than a duplicate place.

review.notes: Fail-closed Næringsliv package that distinguishes building, institution, production unit, predecessor theatre layer and current property management.
